name: Snake Salve
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 1st; Slot none; Price 150 gp; Weight —.

DESCRIPTION

This thick paste is made from strange dried herbs, powdered adamantine, and other rare ingredients. If rubbed on the head of a snake, it acts as a magic fang spell when the command word is spoken.

Once activated, snake salve lasts for one minute.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, magic fang; Cost 75 gp.
